title: Devotional date lookup can 500 when fallback language has multiple rows
reasoning: The requested-language and English lookups catch only DoesNotExist, then the final fallback calls Devotional.objects.get(day__church=church, day__date=target_date) without filtering language. If a date has more than one devotional row in different languages, get() raises MultipleObjectsReturned, which is not handled and will produce a server error instead of returning a deterministic fallback devotional.
reproduction: Create two Devotional rows for the same church/date with different language_code values, then request that date with a lang that does not match either row; the final unqualified get() can raise MultipleObjectsReturned.
recommendation: Replace the unqualified fallback get() with a deterministic query such as filter(...).order_by(...).first(), or explicitly choose a language fallback order and handle MultipleObjectsReturned.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests are for admin duplication and do not exercise devotional lookup or multilingual fallback behavior.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a test for DevotionalByDateView with multiple language rows on the same date and an unsupported requested language, asserting a 200 response with a selected fallback instead of an error.
minimumFixScope: Adjust DevotionalByDateView.get_object's final fallback query to avoid unhandled MultipleObjectsReturned.
